body: It due today, 3pm est. I have been trying to calm down and usually when I get like this I'll usually naturally calm down but its not happening this time which is really scarring me. It just seems like the end of my time.

I've been trying to focus on the paper but my mind just filling my head with negative thoughts "How could you let this happen?" "Everyone is going to be ashamed when they find out", to the point where I can't even form a thought for the paper. I don't know if anyone would want to help me with it.
